title: Headcount routing evaluation case
description: One line of cases.jsonl. This schema documents the shape for humans and external tooling; scripts/validate-routing-evals.py is the authoritative checker and additionally verifies what a schema cannot — that every referenced skill exists on disk, that ids are unique across the file, and that every installed skill is covered or explicitly exempted.

id.description: Unique, stable, lowercase-hyphenated. Never reuse an id: results are compared across runs by id.

prompt.description: The natural-language request, written the way someone would actually ask it.

expected.description: The skill(s) that should activate. The first entry is the ideal answer; recall is measured against this list. Empty for ambiguous or negative-only cases.

acceptable.description: Selections that pass without being the ideal answer — legitimate ambiguity, recorded rather than papered over.

forbidden.description: Skills that must NOT activate for this prompt. A forbidden selection fails the case regardless of anything else.

tags.description: Free grouping labels: a department, plus markers like positive, negative, ambiguous, near-neighbor, boundary, underspecified, expert-phrasing, readme-example.

skillRef.description: A department:skill address that must resolve to plugins/<department>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md.
